messages.author: ffd4a53024d34dff
messages.subject: Is there a COMPLETE data dictionary for GGIR outputs?
parts:
Hi,
I wonder if there is a full/complete data dictionary or codebook for GGIR outputs. I know that the vignettes webpage clarifies full or part of the variable names "for which the meaning may not be obvious", but I'm new working with this type of data and a lot of names are not obvious to me. Hopefully there is a data dictionary created but I haven't found it. Any help would be greatly appreciated. 
Thanks in advance!
Olivia

messages.author: 5270e62a7d3ec577
messages.subject: Re: Is there a COMPLETE data dictionary for GGIR outputs?
parts:
Hi both,

Have you used the online manual and looked at the naming structures for the output variables? This can be found here: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIR.html#4_Inspecting_the_results

Perhaps you could give a few examples of some of the output variable names you aren't sure of as a guider? It's certainly difficult to give an exhaustive list/data dictionary because you can customise so many of the output variables - which is one of GGIR's key strengths.

Kind regards,
Ben
